videos.title: Holtz-Eakin: 50bps Hike Would Send ‘Important Message’
videos.description: American Action Forum President Douglas Holtz-Eakin says a half-point Federal Reserve rate hike would send an important message that policymakers are serious about returning inflation to target. The former Congressional Budget Office director says, however, tariffs and market volatility could ultimately lead the Fed to opt for a quarter-point move instead. He speaks with Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
